scripts.build: dotnet build server/MessagingServer.slnx && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.migrate: dotnet ef database update -s server/src/Api -p server/src/Infrastructure
scripts.migration:add: dotnet ef migrations add -s server/src/Api -p server/src/Infrastructure
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "dotnet watch --project server/src/Api" "npm --prefix client run dev"
